SELECT id, type, name, sort, status, update_time FROM category
ORDER BY sort ASC, update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category ( type, name, sort, status, create_user, update_user ) VALUES ( #{type}, #{name}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, name, sort, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user FROM category WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, type, name, sort, status, update_time FROM category WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY sort ASC, update_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, type, name, sort, status, update_time FROM category WHERE type = #{type} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, update_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET type = #{type}, name = #{name}, sort = #{sort}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id}
